mapper.select:
select f.id as family_id, f.name as family_name, f.merchant_id, m.name as merchant_name, f.note, f.contact_names_json, f.delivery_enabled, f.delivery_fee_default, f.delivery_fee_free, (select address_text from family_addresses where family_id = f.id and is_default = 1 limit 1) as default_address_text, (select count(*) from family_addresses where family_id = f.id) as address_count, (select count(*) from family_user_relations where family_id = f.id and status='ACTIVE') as member_count, (select count(*) from family_menu_items where family_id = f.id and enabled = 1) as active_menu_count, (select count(*) from family_user_relations fr left join member_wallets mw on mw.user_id = fr.user_id where fr.family_id = f.id and fr.status='ACTIVE' and coalesce(mw.balance_amount, 0) < 20) as low_balance_member_count, (select coalesce(sum(mw.frozen_amount), 0) from family_user_relations fr left join member_wallets mw on mw.user_id = fr.user_id where fr.family_id = f.id and fr.status='ACTIVE') as frozen_balance_total from families f join merchants m on m.id = f.merchant_id where f.id = #{familyId}
and f.merchant_id = #{merchantId}

select u.id as member_id, u.nickname as name, fr.family_role as role_template, coalesce(w.balance_amount, 0) as available_balance, coalesce(w.frozen_amount, 0) as frozen_balance from users u join family_user_relations fr on fr.user_id=u.id and fr.status='ACTIVE' left join member_wallets w on w.user_id = u.id where u.id = #{memberId}

select o.id as orderId, ms.name as mealSlotName, o.status, o.total_amount as totalAmount from orders o left join meal_slots ms on ms.id = o.meal_slot_id where o.family_id = #{familyId} order by o.id desc limit 5

select d.id as dishId, d.name, coalesce(fmi.final_price, d.base_price) as price, d.image_url as imageUrl from family_menu_items fmi join dishes d on d.id = fmi.dish_id where fmi.family_id = #{familyId} and fmi.enabled = 1 and d.status = 'active' order by fmi.sort_order asc, d.id desc limit 1
select id, family_id, contact_name, contact_phone, address_text, is_default from family_addresses where family_id = #{familyId} order by is_default desc, id desc
mapper.update: update family_addresses set is_default = 0 where family_id = #{familyId}
mapper.insert: insert into family_addresses (family_id, contact_name, contact_phone, address_text, is_default) values (#{familyId}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{addressText}, #{defaultAddress})
mapper.update: update family_addresses set is_default = 1 where family_id = #{familyId} and id = #{addressId}
mapper.delete: delete from family_addresses where family_id = #{familyId} and id = #{addressId}
mapper.select: select d.id as dishId, d.category_id as categoryId, d.name as dishName, d.description, d.image_url as imageUrl, d.base_price as basePrice, fmi.final_price as familyFinalPrice, fmi.enabled, fmi.sort_order as sortOrder from family_menu_items fmi join dishes d on d.id = fmi.dish_id join families f on f.id = fmi.family_id where fmi.family_id = #{familyId} and f.merchant_id = #{merchantId} order by fmi.sort_order asc, d.id desc
select id as meal_slot_id, name, display_time from meal_slots where family_id = #{familyId} and enabled = 1 order by sort_order asc, id asc

select f.id as family_id, f.name as family_name, f.merchant_id, m.name as merchant_name, f.note, f.contact_names_json, f.delivery_enabled, f.delivery_fee_default, f.delivery_fee_free, (select address_text from family_addresses where family_id = f.id and is_default = 1 limit 1) as default_address_text, (select count(*) from family_addresses where family_id = f.id) as address_count, (select count(*) from family_user_relations where family_id = f.id and status='ACTIVE') as member_count, (select count(*) from family_menu_items where family_id = f.id and enabled = 1) as active_menu_count, (select count(*) from family_user_relations fr left join member_wallets mw on mw.user_id = fr.user_id where fr.family_id = f.id and fr.status='ACTIVE' and coalesce(mw.balance_amount, 0) < 20) as low_balance_member_count, (select coalesce(sum(mw.frozen_amount), 0) from family_user_relations fr left join member_wallets mw on mw.user_id = fr.user_id where fr.family_id = f.id and fr.status='ACTIVE') as frozen_balance_total from families f join merchants m on m.id = f.merchant_id where f.merchant_id = #{merchantId} order by f.id desc

select u.id as member_id, u.nickname as name, fr.family_role as role_template, coalesce(w.balance_amount, 0) as available_balance, coalesce(w.frozen_amount, 0) as frozen_balance from family_user_relations fr join users u on u.id=fr.user_id left join member_wallets w on w.user_id = u.id where fr.family_id = #{familyId} and fr.status='ACTIVE' order by u.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into family_menu_items (family_id, dish_id, enabled, sort_order, final_price) values (#{familyId}, #{dishId}, #{enabled}, #{sortOrder}, #{finalPrice})

insert into family_menu_items (family_id, dish_id, enabled, sort_order, final_price) select #{targetFamilyId}, dish_id, enabled, sort_order, final_price from family_menu_items where family_id = #{sourceFamilyId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from families where id = #{familyId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId} and status = 'active'
select count(*) from dishes where id = #{dishId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId} and status in ('active','inactive')
